name: cTSObject::vf65 (the object's footprint rectangles at a position and facing; meaning tentative)
notes: Hooked, not run in game yet. ret 8 (float *position (x, y), const uint32_t *facingNotch), returns the address of the cache vector (this+0x200). First use (byte +0x293 zero): BuildFootprint (0x7eaf50, ours; it is called with the position (0, 0, 0) as three zeroed floats and notch 0 and fills the base list at +0x1e4, a cache of the same layout) builds the base rectangle list (begin/end pointers of 16-byte x1 y1 x2 y2 records), then the byte is set. The cache (begin, end, capacity, min x, min y, max x, max y at +0x200..0x21c) is cleared (end = begin when different) and its extent reset to +-FLT_MAX. Each base rectangle is turned by (notch & 7) (0/1 none; 2/3: x = px - s[1] / px - s[3], y = py + s[0] / py + s[2]; 4/5: x = px - s[0] / px - s[2], y = py - s[3] / py - s[1]; 6/7: x = px + s[3] / px + s[1], y = py - s[2] / py - s[0]) and each axis snapped inwards: low = max(floor(a * 8 + 0.5) * 0.125 + 0.01, a), high = min(ceil(b * 8 - 0.5) * 0.125 - 0.01, b), and for a real interval (b > a) narrower than 0.0625 the high is low + 0.125 - 0.02 (single precision, maxss/minss operand order, NaN as the hardware); the game's floor/ceil (0x838c10, 0x82f6e0, CRT equivalents) are the toolchain's. Extent updates use strict compares (NaN never updates). The snapped rectangle is stored at the end of the cache; when it is full (end == capacity) the vector's growing insert 0x255f70 (thiscall: vector, where = end, value) does it (original call; stood in on both sides, a std::vector<float[4]> instantiation not yet replaced). Difftest: 40,000 seeds, all eight notches (and high bits), grid-aligned, margin-offset, tiny, negative and NaN/infinite coordinates, 0..8 base rectangles, cache vectors empty/null/full/partial, with the builder either run or skipped. 19 of 20 mutants killed (grid constant signs, floor/ceil swap, axis mapping per rotation, notch mask, narrow rule and its guard, min/max operand order, extent compares and reset, clear, flag store, position axis, grow argument); the survivor (full test end + 4 <= capacity vs end != capacity) is equivalent for 16-byte-aligned pointers. The builder is stood in on both sides (the image function and our BuildFootprint are patched).

name: BuildFootprint (fill a footprint cache with an object's rectangles at a position and notch; tentative name)
notes: Hooked, not run in game yet. cdecl (object, float *position (x, y), const uint32_t *notch, FootprintCache *cache), void. half = FootprintSize / 2 (0x7e86e0, ours); the square {x - half, y - half, x + half, y + half}. Margins: the attribute table (slot 64) slot 5 (0x4d) as four nibbles in 1/16 steps (left, bottom, right, top). Kind 2 (slot 98): the helper interface 0x5a69d3d5 (slot 0, answer al) with an even notch gives its slot 10 (0x49, 1): the same four nibbles are subtracted from the margins. Other kinds with the low byte of attribute 8 not negative: slot 85 (out: 12 bytes) gives an origin; its x and y become tile numbers by the game's rounding (add 0.5, subtract 0.5, add 1.5 * 2^23 and take the integer from the float bits, plus one if that next integer equals the shifted value); slot 107's low byte and the float bits of the y rounding (upper 24 bits, the stack leftover) are the last argument of slot 183 (tile x, tile y, the rectangle buffer (begin, end, capacity, freed through the allocator service with count (capacity - begin) / 16 on every path), 0, that word); when it says al != 0 the cache is cleared and each reported rectangle is turned by the notch, moved, snapped (as vf65) and added (AppendSnappedRect). Otherwise (kind 2, attribute 8 negative, or slot 183 false) one rectangle: the square, or, when any margin is non-zero (NaN counts), turned by q = (8 - FacingPointerToNotch(notch)) / 2: (x1 + m[q % 4], y1 + m[(q + 3) % 4], x2 - m[(q + 2) % 4], y2 - m[(q + 1) % 4]); extent and push as in vf65 (the growing insert 0x255f70 is an original call, stood in on both sides). Difftest: 40,000 seeds, exception injection (>1000), every kind/margin/helper/attribute 8/slot 183 combination, 0..6 reported rectangles with and without buffer storage, NaN/inf coordinates, caches empty/partial/full. 24 mutants killed.
